title: Clearance Review Manifest Preview Tool
claim: Implemented a read-only MCP bridge preview tool for operator review before local clearance creation; source commit, build, tests, lint, and direct built-module validation passed, while live MCP surfacing remains pending bridge reload.
summary: FP-MCP-273 adds a non-mutating preview layer for clearance review. The bridge commit is 1ff559e on feature/oauth-auth0. The new tool name is forgepilot_preview_operator_local_execution_clearance_review_manifest and the new implementation function is previewOperatorLocalExecutionClearanceReviewManifest. The preview shows the operator what to review before the final popup: target packet, request artifact, approval artifact, local clearance output path, exact scope fields, current repository state, expiry, final-brake operator rule, and follow-on side effects. It also reports whether an existing local clearance file is present so the operator can see whether the follow-on clearance action would create a new file or overwrite an old local file. Validation passed with pnpm build, pnpm test, hardcoded packet-id lint, git diff --check, and direct built-module preview invocation. The active MCP runtime did not show the new tool before service reload, so post-reload live surfacing and one live read-only preview call remain follow-up work.
caveats: Live ChatGPT MCP surfacing is pending bridge reload.
Direct validation used an old stale tuple, so the preview correctly reported ineligibility reasons for that tuple.
An old gitignored local clearance file exists and is expired/unusable; FP-MCP-273 did not create or modify it.
This packet implements the preview layer only; it does not run the guarded execution path.

structuredRecord.followUp: Reload MCP bridge, rediscover the new tool, run one live read-only preview call, then admit post-reload surfacing evidence.
